name: SingleCellBench
intro: SingleCellBench 是 LatchBio 开发并在 Claude Sonnet 5 系统卡中披露的单细胞RNA测序分析评测变体，包含195个问题，覆盖细胞类型标注、差异表达分析和批次效应校正；构建与评分细节未公开。
task_type: 生物信息学问答, 数据分析
eval_feature: 单细胞RNA测序分析, 标准生物信息学流程, 协议未披露
eval_feature_en: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis, standard bioinformatics workflows, and an undisclosed protocol
intro_en: SingleCellBench is a LatchBio single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis evaluation disclosed in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card. Its 195 problems cover cell-type labeling, differential-expression analysis, and batch-effect correction; construction and scoring details are not public.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Claude Sonnet 5 System Card Section 8.14.2 LatchBio Bioinformatics, p.142. SingleCellBench is a LatchBio evaluation variant documented only in the Claude Sonnet 5 system card, not in a standalone benchmark paper. The card says it contains 195 problems that test analysis of single-cell RNA-sequencing data across standard workflows including cell-type labeling, differential-expression analysis, and batch-effect correction. It reports aggregate model scores for the variant. The source does not disclose how the 195 problems were sourced or annotated, dataset splits, prompt and tool setup, reference-answer format, per-item scoring rubric, or aggregation formula. The diagram therefore separates the few disclosed task-scope facts from an explicit undisclosed-method boundary instead of inventing a build process.
